_doc: Declares this repo's legal/consent surfaces per cais-shared-services/REGULATORY_INCLUSIONS.md. Every inclusion must be default, customised, or not-applicable WITH A REASON — silence is not acceptance.

operator._doc: Trigger A. DealFindrs is CAS-owned, so it carries OUR canonical identity (portfolio-manifest.yaml `shared:`). Note this is NOT automatic: the property engine is a plausible white-label candidate, and if a distributor ever resells it, this block and every inclusion below must change to theirs.

exposure._doc: Why the bar here is 'correct and honest' rather than 'launch-ready'.
exposure.note: Currently an internal tool — access is the operator's alone. The inclusions are written correctly now rather than left until later, because the failure this standard exists to stop is a placeholder that ships when access opens and nobody re-reads it.
exposure.before_public: Separate legal review before the product moves to public access. Re-run checks #44-#46 at that point; several 'not-applicable' declarations below become live the moment there are real customers.

review.note: Best-fit pages, not legal advice. Reviewed properly before public exposure — see `exposure.before_public`.

privacy.note: Existed with real content but named NO entity and NO ABN — it described what we do with data without ever identifying who 'we' are, which is the thing a privacy policy has to establish before the rest of it means anything. Added as §1, with the full identification block and the OAIC complaint pathway in the contact section.

terms.note: Acceptance / service / data / acceptable use / billing / liability / contact. Contact block now carries entity, ABN and postal address rather than a trading name alone.

voice.reason: No voice agent on the deployed product today. The repo has an unmerged feat/voice-clarifier-and-admin-team branch — re-declare this as `default` the moment that lands, because the ElevenLabs vendor consent modal arrives with it.

ip_ack.reason: Users do not create or share content built on third-party IP. Property data entered is the user's own or sourced from the canonical property-services feed under its own terms.

cookies.reason: Session cookie only, strictly necessary to keep a signed-in user signed in. Usage metadata mentioned in the privacy policy is first-party product telemetry, not cross-site tracking. Re-declare the moment any third-party analytics is added.

sender.note: Canonical CAS identity via @caistech/email-compliance. Transactional only today.
